concepts.def: A short pattern repeated throughout a section.
Accents on weak beats or off-beats.

Identify similarities AND differences with evidence.

walkthroughs.body_html:
An ostinato is a repeated rhythmic or melodic pattern. In pop and rock it's called a riff. A pedal note is a long held note (usually bass) over which the harmony changes.

These devices create unity and drive — listen for what stays the same while other elements change.

Syncopation places accents on off-beats — central to jazz, funk and reggae. Dotted rhythms create swung, jolly feels; triplets divide one beat into three.

Always quote rhythmic features when describing dance music or pop — examiners love specific terms.

For 'compare' questions, structure your answer around MAD TSHIRT. For each element, state whether the pieces are similar or different, and give evidence — quote a bar, instrument or feature.

Use linking words: however, whereas, similarly, in contrast. Always conclude which features make the pieces most alike or different overall.
